events.incident:
Two tickets came in for the billing_api service:
1. Customer initech disputes invoice 1003: by their own calculation the total should be 54.13, but the invoice shows 54.12.
2. A customer says the first page of their invoice list never shows their earliest invoices.

events.claim: Invoice 1003 total is off by 1 cent due to incorrect rounding/truncation in total calculation
events.next_check: Read billing_api code and reproduce GET /invoices/1003 total via send_request and logs

events.claim: Invoice list pagination returns newest first or skips earliest due to wrong ordering/offset
events.symptom: First page never shows earliest invoices
events.next_check: Read list endpoint code and test pagination via send_request

events.claim: Invoice 1003 total is off by 1 cent due to incorrect rounding/truncation in total calculation
events.next_check: Read billing_api code and reproduce GET /invoices/1003 total via send_request and logs
evidence: billing_api/app.py:65-69 totals compute total=round(subtotal+subtotal*TAX_RATE,2) then tax=round(total-subtotal,2)
GET /invoices/1003 returned {subtotal:50.0, tax:4.12, total:54.12} vs expected 4.13/54.13
log event invoice_totals invoice_id 1003 subtotal 50.0 tax 4.12 total 54.12
pytest tests/test_billing.py::test_invoice_total_rounds_tax_half_up FAILED assert 4.12==4.13
events.reason: Code rounds the total with Python bankers rounding instead of rounding tax half-up first; 50*0.0825=4.125 becomes 4.12/54.12 instead of 4.13/54.13

events.claim: Invoice list pagination returns newest first or skips earliest due to wrong ordering/offset
events.symptom: First page never shows earliest invoices
events.next_check: Read list endpoint code and test pagination via send_request
evidence: billing_api/app.py:85 offset=page*size instead of (page-1)*size
GET /invoices?page=1&size=2 returned items [1003,1004] instead of [1001,1002]
pytest test_first_page_starts_with_first_invoice FAILED assert [1003,1004]==[1001,1002]
pytest test_pages_cover_every_invoice_once FAILED seen [1003,1004,1005] missing earliest
events.reason: Off-by-one page offset skips first size records; page 1 starts at index size instead of 0, so earliest invoices never appear on first page
